name: Hubby's back
steps: 1.Drag the green bathrobe from the statue onto the woman so she gets dressed.
2.Drag the green towel onto the woman’s head.
3.Drag the mop from the corner across the floor to clean up the mess.
4.Drag the man onto the statue pedestal to make him pose as a statue.
5.Tap the phone on the table and tap the red trash can icon to delete the photo.
6.Drag the hammer onto the broken sofa to repair it.
7.Drag the trash bag out of the window to throw away the garbage.
8.Drag the wet cloth over the statue man to wipe off the lipstick marks.
9.Drag the green paint bucket over the statue man to paint him fully green.
10.Drag the fish bone to the white cat so it leaves the room.
